name: RIKEI CORPORATION
court: inline advance court, main session 2026-08-03 (agent budget exhausted); generator was the mechanical EDINET shelf + FX overlay, so the generator-never-grades-itself invariant holds; no score reached 6 so no red team required
fx_context: USD/JPY 163.85 (Jul-23) -> 157.19 (Aug-2), +4.2% yen; IBKR IDEALPRO daily mid, tape-verified
verdict: PASS 3/10 — the 39% fall is a 40% profit downgrade being priced correctly, and the 52-week high was an artifact
mode_b_first: Independent read: the drawdown looks like a dislocation and is not. FY3/27 guides operating profit from JPY 1,236m to JPY 740m, down 40.1%, with the operating margin going 6.33% -> 3.92%. Against the GUIDED year the stock is ~9.5x forward EBIT at 0.94x book, which is not cheap enough to pay for a 40% earnings reset. Worse, the 52-week high that frames the '39% below' statistic was itself manufactured: a 26% upward revision on 2026-02-09 spiked the price to 614 and it reversed 9.5% within the same week, then fell 17% on the FY3/26 print in May. Anchoring on that high is the window-anchoring error the ONTO court taught us to refuse.
fx_note: imported IBM/HPE hardware means real COGS relief (~+26% to EBIT on estimated import share), and at a 3.92% guided margin the leverage is meaningful — but it is a mitigant against a 40% downgrade, not a thesis. The FX tailwind and the earnings reset point in opposite directions and the reset is the larger, better-evidenced number.

mode_a_verification.capital_return: no buyback in 18 months, lowest yield in the batch
mode_a_verification.tax_profile: cleanest PFIC headroom in the ten at 0.33; JPY 37,300 board lot makes accumulation trivial
mode_a_verification.size_caution: $36M market cap — smallest in the batch; position size is capped by liquidity before conviction

entry_plan.rationale: ~0.75x book and ~6x the GUIDED (not trailing) EBIT — the level that pays for the reset. 17-22% below spot
entry_plan.sizing: 0.2% maximum on the market cap alone

kill_triggers: ROE falls below 8% on the reset base
any further upward-revision-then-reversal pattern (the Feb-2026 sequence repeating would indicate guidance games)
adjudication_spec: FY3/27 H1 (Nov-2026): is the 3.92% guided margin a trough or a new level? Two consecutive quarters at or above guide = trough thesis lives and the band applies; below guide = leaves the shelf.
